principle: Bountiful may use a small number of unique public-notice proof items only when the target is appropriate to the issuing tier and does not overlap an authored villager recovery site. Authored recovery owns the deeper physical evidence flow and must have one player-visible truth.
placement_semantics: Public notice proofs are deterministic loot-table inserts for lightweight local board work. They are not quest-bound villager evidence. Any structure family used by an authored recovery is excluded from this static proof system.

retired.reason: Retired in 0.4.1 because Temple of Eight Roots uses Jungle Monument as an authored recovery candidate; a second static quest-looking object at that site violated the one-visible-truth rule.
Retired in 0.4.1 because The Last Warm Camp uses Ice Pit as an authored recovery site; the old Hearthlands board contract also crossed too far outward for an ordinary public notice.
